reviews.text: This game is not for beginners—it can be tough to get into at first due to the large number of items. The atmosphere and execution are great. The developer is clearly working hard on the game, which shows in the amount of updates. In the beginning, the game might feel a bit boring. Overall: 7-8/10
A dark roguelike where every run starts with confidence and ends with a valuable lesson about overconfidence
Fantastic roguelike. Easy to learn, hard to master. Immersive atmosphere and graphics. Snappy controls. Bangin' music. Obscurity Unlocked recommends RAZE.
RAZE offers a captivating blend of strategy and action. The mechanics are well-designed, making each session feel fresh and engaging. I recommend it to fans of the genre.
hardcore, adrenaline-fueled roguelike where survival depends on your reflexes! Slaughtering hordes and adapting to random events is a true challenge for genre fans.
RAZE is a top-down roguelike where you fight to save the Shadow World from a rogue god. Master simple, skill-based movement, gear up with massive arsenals, and climb global online rankings.
I appreciate the immersive atmosphere and polished mechanics in RAZE. The combat feels satisfying, and the storyline kept me engaged throughout the experience.
RAZE offers a compelling mix of strategy and action that I found refreshing. The level design is well thought out, making each encounter uniquely challenging and rewarding.
I appreciate the level of depth in RAZE's game design. The variety of units and tactics allows for creative gameplay, although the learning curve can be steep at times.
RAZE captures my attention with its fast-paced combat and intricate level designs. It rewards tactical thinking and adaptability, making each match feel fresh and challenging.
I had a blast playing RAZE. The fast-paced gameplay kept me hooked, and the graphics are surprisingly good for an indie title. Definitely worth a try.
RAZE surprised me with its charm. The combat mechanics are smooth, and I love the variety of weapons. I found myself playing for hours without realizing it.
